rationale: The stock gapped down ~7.5% on earnings beat news (counterintuitive price action suggesting sell-the-news or broader market pressure), then recovered sharply from $148.17 to $162.71, now sitting at 88.8% of today's range near the session high with the last candle showing a small pullback.
